L31·N8648unmasked layer
This neuron distinguishes sentence-continuation from sentence-completion: it fires positively on tokens in the middle of an unfinished phrase (a preposition/quantifier/word-piece with more to come, e.g. "in stock **in**", "$0**.**50", "Tabith**a**", "Items **such** as", "lovely **homemade**"), and is strongly suppressed (large negative) by the final head noun of a clause immediately before a period ("aspects.", "role.", "assets.", "laboratories.").
